description.purpose: Independent dated, site-bound reviewed legal government/authority input to the canonical BCM ProjectVerifier via Runtime.
description.usage: Private RSO/jurisdiction research must provide accepted bytes under the public JSON Schema and paired ODCS definition; the BCM operator independently approves and pins a policy SHA-256 before configuring Runtime. Provider cannot set this policy. Use only after verified source custody and review.
description.limitations: Structure, provenance references and a matching SHA-256 cannot authenticate reviewer/legal source, establish original-object custody, legal site membership, signed delegation or an enacted code edition. No real Colorado policy exists in this reference application. Do not manufacture legal verdicts from candidates or date-free name joins.

properties.name: rules
properties.description: Operator-reviewed site witness set; never supplied by Provider

properties.name: rules[].location_sha256
properties.description: Exact hash of normalized query site, separate from date/facts

properties.name: rules[].location_precision
properties.description: Independent address point or parcel; interpolated forbidden

properties.name: rules[].authority_id
properties.description: Enforcement authority; duplicate active authorities reject

properties.name: rules[].review_state
properties.description: Operator source admission recorded; not self-verifying

properties.name: rules[].boundary.site_relation
properties.description: Reviewed interior membership with no unresolved boundary conflict

properties.name: rules[].boundary.crosswalk_review_sha256
properties.description: Independent governmental identity/census disagreement review receipt

properties.name: rules[].legal.exact_text_sha256
properties.description: Reviewed operative exact source passage digest

properties.name: rules[].legal.enforcement_mode
properties.description: Direct or legally delegated; delegation artifact required if delegated

properties.name: rules[].provenance.entity_uri
properties.description: W3C PROV Entity of reviewed source

properties.name: rules[].provenance.activity_uri
properties.description: W3C PROV Activity independently reviewing mapping

properties.name: rules[].provenance.agent_uri
properties.description: W3C PROV Agent accountable for review
